items.title: xikhar/persona
items.why: A useful open-source project to check out if you want to build interactive voice-driven AI agents.
items.summary: An open-source project for integrating real-time voice capabilities into AI applications.

items.title: mshumer/Claude-of-Duty
items.why: A impressive demonstration of how LLMs can generate complete 3D web games from simple prompts.
items.summary: A Call of Duty-style first-person shooter game built entirely in Three.js generated from a single AI prompt.

items.title: wassgha/rescript
items.why: A neat open-source web app showing how speech-to-text can power innovative media editing UI.
items.summary: An open-source browser tool that lets you edit video and audio directly by editing the generated transcript.

items.title: achimala/TheLongSilence
items.why: Another great example of AI-assisted game development that you can study to see what modern LLMs can code.
items.summary: A full space exploration game generated completely by Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 model.

items.title: PipeNetwork/kimi-k3-mlx
items.why: If you want to run new open models on Apple Silicon (Mac), this project shows how to run Kimi-K3 locally with MLX.
items.summary: MLX port of Kimi-K3 for Apple Silicon, allowing local execution, expert pruning, and analysis on Mac hardware.

items.title: Solving poker in custom WebGPU kernels
items.why: It is a cool example of GPU programming in the browser using WebGPU, which is very relevant if you're curious about low-level graphics and performance.
items.summary: A poker solver built directly on custom WebGPU kernels to run cheaply and fast inside client browsers.

items.title: NikolayS/PGSimCity
items.why: A fun and intuitive educational project to help you visualize core database concepts as a CS student.
items.summary: An interactive 3D city that visually represents how the PostgreSQL database engine functions under the hood.

items.title: xdash/FDE-the-Guidance-Book-of-Forward-Deployed-Engineer
items.why: A great career resource if you want to learn about engineering roles that bridge software development and customer solutions.
items.summary: A guide covering the roles, responsibilities, and skill sets needed for Forward Deployed Engineers at tech startups.

items.title: Google pauses AI satellite images, after fears of deepfakes in the sky
items.why: It highlights an important real-world debate on AI ethics and the risks of synthetic media.
items.summary: Google paused its AI satellite imagery feature after concerns were raised about the potential for boundless disinformation and deepfakes.

items.title: Is AI reasoning right for the wrong reasons?
items.why: As a CS student, understanding the limits and reliability of LLM reasoning logic will help you build better AI applications.
items.summary: An exploration of whether AI reasoning models actually follow sound logic or just arrive at correct answers by coincidence.

items.title: Everyone is building LLM routers, we deprecated ours
items.why: This offers great practical system architecture insights into the trade-offs of building LLM-powered applications.
items.summary: A real-world engineering post discussing why one team abandoned LLM routers in favor of simpler architecture.

items.title: Spain's PM blames traffickers after 60,000 migrants reach Ceuta from Morocco
items.why: This is major world news regarding international migration and European border policy.
items.summary: Thousands of migrants arrived in Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta from Morocco, leading to troop deployments and diplomatic strain.
